note: Dated procurement record only. The August 2026 platform exports appear as a separate, explicitly discontinuous plane and are not connected to any 2023 event by line, arrow or motion.

date_precision_legend.day: day-level date printed on the instrument
date_precision_legend.recital: date known from a recital in another instrument; the executed instrument itself has not been produced
date_precision_legend.ocr_handwriting: read from handwriting in a scan; exact digits not reliable

rows.title: Sourcewell issues RFP #010720
rows.summary: Public notice of a solicitation for “Public Safety Video Surveillance Solutions with Related Equipment, Software and Accessories.”

rows.title: Contract 010720-WCH takes effect
rows.summary: Sourcewell contracts with WatchGuard Video, Inc. Expires 21 February 2024, extendable one year.

rows.title: Change form repricing the VaaS offering
rows.summary: Creates the VaaS price list that the next form says the plate reader was left off of. Its signature is dated “8/31/22” — an anomaly on the face of the document.
rows.instrument: Price and Product Change Request, eff. 9-3-2021

rows.title: Plate readers added to the price list
rows.summary: A two-page vendor change request: “WatchGuard Video mistakenly left off a key component of our VaaS offering – The License Plate Reader (LPR).”
rows.instrument: Price and Product Change Request, eff. 9-14-2021

rows.title: Combined in-car video and plate-reader unit added
rows.summary: A further change form adds the next-generation combined unit and a new price-list format.
rows.instrument: Price and Product Change Request, eff. 10-29-2021

rows.title: WatchGuard integrated into Motorola
rows.summary: Amendment #2 renames the contract's supplier to Motorola Solutions, Inc.

rows.title: Price file: “In-Car Video (ICV) & License Plate Reader (LPR) Systems”
rows.summary: Defines DDN3421A as CarDetector Mobile with Vigilant PlateSearch, agency data only, and lists the commercial-data ladder separately.
rows.instrument: Motorola (fka WatchGuard) price file, eff. June 2022

rows.title: Short Form Agreement W23-383 term begins
rows.summary: The City's plate-reader software agreement with Vigilant Solutions, LLC, under Houston-Galveston Area Council master agreement EF04-21.

rows.title: Commercial national vehicle-location data quoted
rows.summary: VS-IDP-03: $11,250 a year for three years, reverting to $31,440 a year. Ten Mobile Companion licences at $0 in year one.

rows.title: Three Vigilant addenda dated
rows.summary: Software Subscription Addendum, Vigilant Addendum and Data License Addendum. Known from a recital; the executed instruments have not been produced.

rows.title: Fixed roadside cameras quoted
rows.summary: “Updated Crocker St LPR”: six fixed L5F cameras and two communications boxes, $68,304 less an $11,534 discount.

rows.title: Commercial data invoiced against Contract 24089
rows.summary: $33,750 for the period August 2023 to September 2026. The PO document itself has not been produced.

rows.title: City PO 24131 issued for the fixed cameras
rows.summary: “Fixed Cameras for the Learn Software”, $56,770, account JAG00020. Part of the purchase in Contract 24089.

rows.title: Amendment adding the ability to purchase plate-reader equipment
rows.summary: Signed for the City by the Deputy City Manager. Purpose: “to add on the ability for the City to purchase LPR Equipment.”

rows.title: QUOTE-2241626 “Updated M500 VaaS”
rows.summary: 130 systems, five years of cloud video-as-a-service, $1,500,080. Includes $67,080 of plate-reader licensing and a $500 support line.

rows.title: Roll Call 23-1629 adopted on the consent agenda
rows.summary: Agenda item 32, within the consent agenda covering items 3 through 38. Council Communication 23-519 describes upgraded in-car video systems and video evidence management software.

rows.title: Mobile Video, Subscription Software and EPSLA addenda executed
rows.summary: All three bear the date 20 November 2023. The Mobile Video Addendum's plate-reader clause sits at page 9 of the 25-page clerk's file.

rows.title: City PO 24209 issued
rows.summary: $1,500,080 across FY24-FY28, citing Roll Call 23-1629 and all four addenda.

rows.title: Short Form Agreement W24-152 commences
rows.summary: Its order-of-precedence clause points at an EPSLA and a Software License Addendum executed “on or around September 29, 2023.”

rows.title: 130 systems delivered
rows.summary: The pack list records an “M500 ALPR DVR” component for every unit.

rows.title: City states activation
rows.summary: The City gives the activation date as January 2024.

rows.title: Year-one invoice
rows.summary: $315,688.20, including $58,228.30 of M500 Basic ALPR VaaS and $926.80 of plate-reader remote support.

rows.title: DMPD General Order Chapter 25 issued
rows.summary: The department's ALPR policy — about four months after the purchase. It sets a 30-day retention period and requires regular audits of ALPR inquiries.

rows.title: Fixed-camera order confirmed through the cooperative
rows.summary: H-GAC order confirmation CC24-01277, product VSF-025-RHD, $56,770.

rows.title: Year-two subscription invoiced for 126 systems
rows.summary: $240,618.92 — four fewer systems than were purchased.

rows.title: Internal audit review, 500 records
rows.summary: The one audit entry in the record, described by the City as a review of searches to ensure case numbers were documented.

rows.title: One bilateral sharing MOU
rows.summary: Sarpy County Sheriff's Office (NE) to DMPD, with Des Moines as the receiving agency.

rows.title: City states it does not keep copies of search logs
rows.summary: Responding to a records request: “search logs are not something the City generates or keeps copies of.” The same response gives 120 in-car and 2 fixed ALPR systems.

rows.title: 2026 renewal: “PREVIOUS COUNCIL ACTION(S): NONE”
rows.summary: Council Communication 26-235 seeks continuation of plate-reader software under a different cooperative contract. Sidebar only — never spliced into 2023.

snapshot_plane.title: Three exports generated from the City's VehicleManager account
snapshot_plane.summary: Sharing report at 10:40, systems and cameras at 10:38, users at 10:42. A snapshot of settings, not a history of them.
snapshot_plane.discontinuity_copy: The records reviewed do not establish when any of these settings was created. Nothing below can be connected in time to anything above.
